columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier. Part of the natural address (sku, location). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Warehouse / bin location. Part of the natural address (sku, location). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Business inventory classification code. NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Current stock level. NOT NULL and >= 0 per PI2 and PI3.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Identity of the user or system that last filed this record. Immutable-pattern: set on insert, preserved through upsert unless explicitly provided.

columns.name: filed_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the record was first filed. Set once on insert; NFR-F1-1 requires this be immutable across additive migrations.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent upsert. Updated on each write.

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records table with columns: id (uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()), sku (varchar(255) NOT NULL), location (varchar(255) NOT NULL), inventory_code (varchar(100) NOT NULL), quantity (integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), actor (varchar(255) NOT NULL), filed_at (timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()), updated_at (timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()). Add UNIQUE constraint on (sku, location). Add CHECK (quantity >= 0). Add indexes on (sku, location) unique, (sku), and (location).
schema_changes.migration_note: Downgrade drops the stock_records table entirely. Migration is additive (new table only); existing tables are untouched, satisfying PI5-migration-reversible. The upsert (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (sku, location) DO UPDATE) must execute inside a single transaction to satisfy PI4-upsert-atomic.
